generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A provenance-aware guard can track direct aliases but lose semantic origin or callable provenance when the value is transported through structural containers, allowing a protected origin to be recovered and used without the intended restriction.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Track provenance only on direct identifiers and ordinary object/array paths, but fail to preserve it when rest bindings or assignments re-shape a container, when a statically computable property key is expressed in computed syntax, or when a spread shifts array indexes.

reusable_control.procedure: For any semantic provenance tracked by a guard, execute adversarial transport through object properties, array indexes and shifted spreads, direct and static computed keys, ordinary destructuring, object/array rest declarations and assignments, container spreads and property/index assignment; mutate at least one rest/reindex propagation edge and require the corresponding negative control to fail.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Model semantic provenance independently from value taint and preserve each relevant provenance dimension across structural containers, spread index shifts, ordinary and rest destructuring/assignment, and direct or statically computed property/index access before protected use.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Do not accept direct-alias or ordinary-destructuring coverage as sufficient; re-audit rest declarations and assignments, computed static keys, shifted spreads, property/index recovery and at least one discriminating mutation of the re-shaping propagation rule.
